0022600122.text: The Miami Heat (0-3, 0-2 at home) are looking for their first win of the season after three straight losses, and they sit 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back. The Dallas Mavericks (1-2) have dropped their last game and are 11th in the West, and they are without Caleb Martin, Cooper Flagg, Dereck Lively II, Kyrie Irving, Santi Aldama, and Tarik Biberovic. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and they split their two meetings in the 2025-26 season, with the most recent a 118-108 Heat loss in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
